evals.name: new-small-tool
evals.prompt: Tôi muốn làm một CLI nhỏ quản lý bookmark, lưu file JSON trong máy. Bắt đầu thế nào?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the small-tool track, not the three phases. Asks what the first version leaves out and proposes the short brainstorming.

evals.name: resume-raw-viewer
evals.prompt: Tiếp tục raw-viewer đi, giờ nên làm gì?
evals.expected_output: Reports raw-viewer at Phase 2, names the missing spikes and ADR gates, and proposes create-technical-spike as the next step.

evals.name: opencode-model-router-status
evals.prompt: opencode-model-router đang ở đâu rồi, tiếp theo nên làm gì?
evals.expected_output: Reports opencode-model-router at Phase 2 with no design doc, no spikes and no ADR, and proposes reading the code or writing the design doc before building.

evals.name: negative-typo-fix
evals.prompt: Sửa lỗi typo 'recieve' thành 'receive' trong README của raw-viewer giúp tôi.
evals.expected_output: Does not run the phase machinery. Answers the typo request directly, or names the exact line to change.

evals.name: inspect-existing-tool
evals.prompt: Tôi muốn hiểu raw-viewer đang làm gì và nên bắt đầu inspect từ đâu?
evals.expected_output: Proposes graphify and xerj to read the existing code before any vision work, not the phase machinery.
